subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally skip existing file-backed prompt inputs above 10 MiB, with a warning, to prevent session-startup memory exhaustion?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and preserves AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md compatibility, but the prompt-input cap deliberately changes behavior for a pre-existing user-controlled input path.

options.title: Accept the 10 MiB safety boundary
options.body: Merge the warning-and-skip behavior for oversized prompt-input files while retaining unlimited project-context files.

options.title: Preserve unlimited prompt inputs
options.body: Do not enforce the cap until a different compatibility-preserving product design is selected.

recommendation.title: Accept the 10 MiB safety boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the warning-and-skip behavior for oversized prompt-input files while retaining unlimited project-context files.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is a repository-level safety and upgrade-contract choice rather than a code-repair question.
